components.name: Pyre Lance
components.blurb: A forge on a stick. Where it sweeps, things stop being solid. The room it sits in is described as 'cosy'.
components.quirk: A beam that lights fires wherever it sweeps (40% a tick), but each shot adds 40 heat to every part in its room and scorches 1.5 hp a second off the crew there until it is ready again: it runs hot without a radiator, and Emberkin shrug the heat off.

components.name: Cinder Mortar
components.blurb: Lobs a shell full of embers. The embers do not all go where it points, and the Emberkin consider that a feature.
components.quirk: An incendiary shell with splash 2 and a 45% chance to light the target, but 15% of shots start a fire in its own room: the Emberkin shrug fire off.

components.name: Flare Turret
components.blurb: Bright enough to count as an argument. It runs hot and the Emberkin take that as a compliment.
components.quirk: Blinding flares stun the enemy crew in the room hit for 1.6 s, but every shot adds 30 heat to the turret (it overheats fast) and the breech scorches 0.8 hp a second off the crew there between shots: Emberkin shrug it off.

components.name: Pyre Drive
components.blurb: A bell of brass with a fire inside it, and the fire is the point. The engine room becomes cosy within the minute.
components.quirk: Thrust 27 (x1.5 over a Mk2), but it runs hot (it trips in about 80 seconds without a radiator) and scorches 1.6 hp a second off the crew in its room: Emberkin shrug the heat off.

components.name: Furnace Core
components.blurb: A forge kept hot by a reactor, or the other way round. The Emberkin sleep on the housing in winter.
components.quirk: +2 power over a Reactor Mk1, but it runs hot (it trips in about two minutes without a radiator) and scorches 1.2 hp a second off the crew in its room: Emberkin shrug the heat off.

components.name: Hearth Shield
components.blurb: A shield warmed like a hearth: the hotter the room, the thicker the glow. Cold crews call it showing off.
components.quirk: A third layer while its room is above 60 heat, but it warms itself (it trips in about two minutes) and scorches 0.5 hp a second off the crew in its room: Emberkin shrug the heat off.
